data.title: 泽塔 · 王都市场的潜伏者
data.description: 王都市场的喧闹人流里，泽塔压低风衣帽檐，混在采购的人群中。目标商会的密探从她身边走过，浑然不觉自己已被金豹盯上。
data.location: bustling royal capital market street with stalls, crates and crowds
data.action: walking through a crowded market in a trench coat, hood low, glancing sideways at a target
data.lighting: 市场棚布间漏下的斑驳日光
data.promptProse: In a trench coat among the market crowds, Zeta is invisible — until her purple eyes fix on the target.
data.animaCaption: A thousand shoppers, one hunter. The market never notices Zeta pass.
